meaning: Coverage of current sponsor names by each evidence source; not a product accuracy score

register.source: Home Office Register of Licensed Sponsors (Workers)

companyIdentity.source: Companies House Free Company Data Product
companyIdentity.basis: Distinct current sponsor names with a safely attached Companies House record
companyIdentity.note: Coverage is not accuracy. No link and no warning are not an all-clear.

historicalCos.basis: Exact case-sensitive employer name occurring once in the current sponsor register
historicalCos.note: Assignments under an exact published employer name; not workers, visa grants, occupations or current vacancies.

cosUsage2025.basis: Exact case-sensitive employer name occurring once in the current sponsor register
cosUsage2025.note: Published employer-route counts of five or more recorded as CoS used; absence is unknown, not zero.

earlyWarningTrackRecord.note: No predictive track record is published until every requirement is met. Associations are never presented as safety scores.

interpretation: Coverage measures whether evidence can be attached without guessing; it does not prove every attached identity is correct.
Missing evidence means unknown, not safe, unsafe or inactive.
Historical CoS assignments do not confirm sponsorship for a current vacancy.
The 2025 used-status disclosure is separate from assignment history and omits counts below five.
